gradients.description: A `Tensor` of type `float32`. Backpropagated gradients above the FakeQuantWithMinMaxVars operation, shape one of: `[d]`, `[b, d]`, `[b, h, w, d]`.
constraints: gradients must be one of float32

inputs.description: A `Tensor` of type `float32`. Values passed as inputs to the FakeQuantWithMinMaxVars operation, shape same as `gradients`. min, max: Quantization interval, floats of shape `[d]`.
constraints: inputs must be one of float32

num_bits.description: An optional `int`. Defaults to `8`. The bitwidth of the quantization; between 2 and 16, inclusive.

narrow_range.description: An optional `bool`. Defaults to `False`. Whether to quantize into 2^num_bits - 1 distinct values.
constraints: narrow_range must be one of bool, False

output.description: A tuple of `Tensor` objects (backprops_wrt_input, backprop_wrt_min, backprop_wrt_max). A `Tensor` of type `float32`. backprop_wrt_min: A `Tensor` of type `float32`. backprop_wrt_max: A `Tensor` of type `float32`.
